mapper.select: select bnd_company_id from t_cmp_binding where bnd_user_id = #{userId} and bnd_status = 1 limit 1
select count(*) from t_pos where pos_company_id = #{companyId} and pos_status = 1
select count(*) from t_sch_appointment a join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.apt_position_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and a.apt_status in (0, 1)

select count(*) from t_int_session s join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and s.ses_status = 2 and s.ses_end_at >= date_sub(curdate(), interval (weekday(curdate())) day)

select count(*) as applied, ifnull(sum(case when tal_status != 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as screened, ifnull(sum(case when tal_status in (2, 4) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as interviewing, ifnull(sum(case when tal_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingInterview, ifnull(sum(case when tal_status = 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rejected, ifnull(sum(case when tal_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as hired from t_tal where tal_company_id = #{companyId} and tal_created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)

select u.nick_name as candidateName, p.pos_title as positionTitle, date_format(a.apt_start_time, '%m-%d %H:%i') as startTime from t_sch_appointment a join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.apt_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.apt_candidate_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and a.apt_status = 0 order by a.apt_start_time desc limit 1

select t.tal_id as talId, u.nick_name as candidateName, p.pos_title as positionTitle from t_int_session s join t_int_evaluation e on e.evl_session_id = s.ses_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = s.ses_candidate_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and e.evl_hr_status = 0 and s.ses_status = 2 order by e.evl_created_at desc limit 1

select u.nick_name as candidateName, t.tal_user_id as peerId, p.pos_title as positionTitle, date_format(a.apt_start_time, '%m-%d %H:%i') as startTime from t_sch_appointment a join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.apt_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.apt_candidate_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and a.apt_status = 1 and a.apt_start_time >= now() order by a.apt_start_time asc limit 1

select u.nick_name as candidateName, l.tsl_to_status as toStatus, date_format(l.tsl_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt from t_tal_status_log l join t_tal t on t.tal_id = l.tsl_candidate_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where t.tal_company_id = #{companyId} order by l.tsl_created_at desc limit 4
